description: ÖPNV Busradar - Bus Live Positionsdaten is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open.NRW. Auf dieser Seite finden Sie Informationen über die Datenschnittstelle der Stadtwerke Münster, über die die Positionsdaten aller Busse im Stadtgebiet live abgefragt werden können. Diese Schnittstelle steht offen und kostenfrei zur Verfügung. Bitte beachten Sie, dass sich diese Schnittstelle in der aktiven Weiterentwicklung befindet und dass es daher zu Ausfällen kommen kann. Coverage: Open.NRW. The portal files it under the publisher Open.NRW. Its tags are transport-und-verkehr. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
